research_rationale: Full frozen recheck resolves the old EO:12743 packet omission: its complete military personnel authorization does not end or amend EO:12722. EO:12724 remains an inconsistency-only partial revocation, EO:12771 expressly saves the Iraqi emergency, EO:12817 supplies transfer machinery, and EO:13303 section 2(a) supplies property-specific nonapplication while section 2(b) preserves other administrative action. EO:13350 confirms emergency termination and revocation effective July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT, with prior-act/matured-rights saving and continued restrictions for still-blocked property. These held spans explain why a current-law reference may concern residual blocking, but do not substitute for the absent operative text of the affirmative current-law leads. The actual remaining blocker is therefore the unresolved current-law conflict, not the now-held EO:12743.
